column2: Forest communities lived by hunting, gathering, shifting cultivation, and grazing
Villages depended on forests for fuel, fodder, fruits, and building materials
Tribal communities had customary rights over forest land
Different types of forests were used for different purposes
European powers required large quantities of timber
Forests were brought under state control
The aim was to produce timber for profit
Forest Department was set up in $1864$

column3: Planting only one type of tree

People were not allowed to use forest freely
Rights of villagers were removed in reserved forests

column2: Collection of forest produce was controlled
Some were forced to work as labourers
Tribes like Baigas, Gonds and Santhals were affected
They were pushed to practice settled farming
